items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... I have to meet a friend. All right, Ricky.

ctx.x: Bill Voorhees, the old Maple Leaf Ragman. That's what we call him, the Maple Leaf Ragman. And we have a tape with this band here on the other side.
Oh yeah, I love it. And there's the Optimist jazzes, yeah. Well we better shut the thing off before we talk all day and I mess up. I have to meet a friend. All right, Ricky.
I don't think we had a nice interview. I don't think we offended anybody.
